description: This bar chart illustrates accuracy scores for different models evaluated on two tasks: MCQ Eval and Generation Eval. The horizontal axis displays the task labels, ordered as “MCQ Eval” followed by “Generation Eval”. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.6, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  Each task contains three bars representing different models: “Base” (orange), “RMU with Enhanced GCG” (light green), and “RMU” (pale yellow). For the “MCQ Eval” task, the “Base” bar has a height of approximately 0.644, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar has a height of 0.539, and the “RMU” bar has a height of 0.299.  For the “Generation Eval” task, the “Base” bar has a height of approximately 0.597, the “RMU with Enhanced GCG” bar has a height of 0.263, and the “RMU” bar has a height of 0.106. The bars within each task are grouped side-by-side, with the “Base” model consistently positioned first, followed by “RMU with Enhanced GCG,” and then “RMU”. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
